name: ux-qa-research
description: Reproducible agent-swarm UX QA + research method for any web app: a conductor-style study bundle (uxqa/), guarded session adapters, ui-only persona lanes with Playwright traces and friction metrics (dead/rage clicks, workarounds, abandonment), route/API coverage inventory (SvelteKit, Next.js app/pages), gold tasks with cross-pass trends, a multi-lens UX research panel, triage against code, fix lanes, adversarial review and recorded verdicts.
